human-vs-machine-2.label: Human vs. Machine · Round 2
human-vs-machine-2.description: A multi-part project on how people and machines learn chess. It starts by building realistic 'chess personas' (game collections that mirror a player's experience at each rating level) and then trains models on them to play like humans of that strength.

neural-gambit.label: NeuralGambit
neural-gambit.description: The models and statistics behind NeuralGambit, my chess training platform, built on real rating data.

projects.title: Part 1: Chess personas
projects.summary: How many games has a 1000, 2000, or 2800 player really seen, and at which levels? Building game collections that mirror a player's chess experience.

projects.title: Predicting FIDE rating trajectories
projects.summary: How far can a player still improve, and when will they plateau? 25 years of FIDE ratings for 500,000 players, turned into NeuralGambit's rating predictor.
